text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle's entry into the Prix 
Jacques Le Marois. Upon hearing her 
declaration—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to rethink it all over again by 
myself. About the great feat I want 
Seeking the Pearl to achieve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I might have taken it a bit too lightly. 
The Prix Jacques Le Marois is indeed a 
top-tier race even among GⅠs."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given its prestige, however, it's a 
formidable hurdle. A mile distance isn't 
necessarily optimal for the current 
Seeking the Pearl, either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could it be... that 'a different race' 
might also be an option for us?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You want me to tell you all about 
European races?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one to consult was Sirius Symboli. A 
hero of overseas challenges who ran freely 
through France and Italy.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, no way. If you just look it up in some 
reference materials or something...
choice_data_list: I can't tell just from that.
I really can't tell just from that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to an actual race, there are 
many things data simply cannot capture.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To unearth new candidates, firsthand 
information was needed. Information based 
on the real experiences of Umamusume who 
had ventured out on expeditions.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk, pissing me off.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That's not it. What pisses me off is your 
eyes. You can't win easily, yet you're 
seriously aiming for victory...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, right, there was some trash. Trash 
I scribbled all over back when I was 
racing abroad in France.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Time to throw this out, I guess. It's 
already in my head anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, Sirius Symboli dumped that very 
garbage right in front of my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we re-examined the best race 
options. The condition is Sprint. And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It has to be held before the Prix Jacques 
le Marois. So that I can claim victory 
before Taiki Shuttle does.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The investigation continued for days and 
days, and then—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what was it you wanted to tell 
me?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wait, found it, you say...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, I handed over a book containing 
information about the race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Prix Maurice de Gheest. A 1,300m 
sprint G1 held in France in early August.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The grass is short, and intense heat can 
make the track bed unusually hard. Because 
of that, races can turn into pure speed 
duels...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this...
choice_data_list: This race is for your sake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I found it, I practically danced for 
joy. Even cross-referencing it with the 
local information from Sirius Symboli, 
there's no issue whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of a kind. In this race, Seeking the 
Pearl will surely...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Maurice... de... Gheest...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You did well to find this... This is... 
destiny.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that name evokes a sense of nostalgia 
and sympathy. Perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is a race of destiny for me. Thank 
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those words... I felt like I had 
arrived. At the absolute answer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can guide Seeking the Pearl 
to the throne of Europe's first GⅠ 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...A bat. But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There is just one thing on my mind. If I 
challenge the Prix Maurice de Gheest and 
win...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Some might see it as 'stealing Taiki's 
thunder.' But you just read the situation 
and made your move..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
They called the one who brought hope to 
the world a "Stealer"... a thief.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that... I caught my breath. It was 
a completely valid concern.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, no matter what anyone says, 
glory is glory. Its value doesn't waver. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In fact, launching an investigation into 
the race came after Taiki Shuttle's 
declaration. That much was certain.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm starting to not understand 
anymore. A promised destiny... I thought 
achieving just that would mean success."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Still, I wonder if that's really okay.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There is a path that follows destiny. 
There is a path that defies destiny. Or 
perhaps, along that defiant path—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Is there a path that surpasses destiny 
too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl was deep in thought 
about something. In the end, she couldn't 
reach a final decision. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I felt that true destiny lay beyond this 
agony. A destiny that Seeking the Pearl 
and I were meant to fulfill together."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, in any case... let's enter the 
"Yasuda Kinen" first.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure Taiki will show us. She doesn't 
say anything, she just purely runs. Even 
so..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki's running will tell us. What we 
ought to do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whichever path you choose to take, it 
won't be too late to decide after running 
the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Prix Maurice de Gheest, or the Prix 
Jacques Le Marois? I decided to leave the 
decision until after the race.
